entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments: ¶<A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised, in the town of our God, in his holy mountain.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: Beautiful in its high position, the joy of all the earth, is the mountain of Zion, the mountain of God, the town of the great King.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: In its buildings God is seen to be a high tower.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: For see! the kings came together by agreement, they were joined together.

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: They saw it, and so were full of wonder; they were troubled, and went quickly away in fear.

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: Shaking came on them and pain, as on a woman in childbirth.

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: By you the ships of Tarshish are broken as by an east wind.

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: ¶As it came to our ears so have we seen it, in the town of the Lord of armies, in the town of our God; God will keep it fixed for ever. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: Our thoughts were of your mercy, O God, while we were in your Temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: As your name is, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: Let there be joy in the mountain of Zion, and let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of your wise decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: Make your way about Zion, and go round it, numbering its towers.

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: Take note of its strong walls, looking well at its fair buildings; so that you may give word of it to the generation which comes after.

entries.title: Psalms 48:14
segments: Because this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide.
